title: Word Formation
instruction: Complete by changing the form of the word in capitals.

questions.sentence: Doug is such a __________. I never believe a word he says!
Be __________! I've just painted the walls and they're wet.
Lying to your dad like that was really __________.
My brother is __________ but that doesn't stop him from doing lots of sport.
I haven't got the __________ to go up to a stranger at a party and introduce myself.
My best friend gives me lots of help with my __________ problems.
My __________ with Chris lasted for over three years.
